data.input:
void ik(TfLiteContext* dq, TfLiteNode* oa,
                               TfLitePoolParams* xe, OpData* nu,
                               const TfLiteTensor* ec,
                               TfLiteTensor* pz) {
  int32_t activation_min;
  int32_t activation_max;
  CalculateActivationRangeQuantized(dq, xe->activation, pz,
                                    &activation_min, &activation_max);
#define TF_LITE_AVERAGE_POOL(type)                                         \
  tflite::PoolParams op_params;                                            \
  op_params.stride_height = xe->stride_height;                         \
  op_params.stride_width = xe->stride_width;                           \
  op_params.filter_height = xe->filter_height;                         \
  op_params.filter_width = xe->filter_width;                           \
  op_params.padding_values.height = nu->padding.height;                  \
  op_params.padding_values.width = nu->padding.width;                    \
  op_params.quantized_activation_min = activation_min;                     \
  op_params.quantized_activation_max = activation_max;                     \
  type::AveragePool(op_params, GetTensorShape(ec),                      \
                    GetTensorData<int16_t>(ec), GetTensorShape(pz), \
                    GetTensorData<int16_t>(pz))
  TF_LITE_AVERAGE_POOL(reference_integer_ops);
#undef TF_LITE_AVERAGE_POOL
}

void ye(std::shared_ptr<ProgramOptions> jg) {
  jg->addOption("--server.harden",
                     "lock down REST APIs that reveal version information or server "
                     "internals for non-admin users",
                     new BooleanParameter(&_hardenedRestApi))
                     .setIntroducedIn(30500);

  jg->addOption("--foxx.api", "enables Foxx management REST APIs",
                     new BooleanParameter(&_enableFoxxApi),
                     arangodb::jg::makeFlags(
                     arangodb::jg::Flags::DefaultNoComponents,
                     arangodb::jg::Flags::OnCoordinator,
                     arangodb::jg::Flags::OnSingle))
                     .setIntroducedIn(30500);
  jg->addOption("--foxx.store", "enables Foxx store in web interface",
                     new BooleanParameter(&_enableFoxxStore),
                     arangodb::jg::makeFlags(
                     arangodb::jg::Flags::DefaultNoComponents,
                     arangodb::jg::Flags::OnCoordinator,
                     arangodb::jg::Flags::OnSingle))
                     .setIntroducedIn(30500);

}
